summary: Revision answering the typed blocked verdict from the first build/implement attempt: preserve the completed provision and contract steps, insert a read-only builder diagnosis of the blocker, re-attempt the implementation with that diagnostic brief plus the build contract to deliver the Astro + MDX stack, meaningful stack-specific test and lint gates, real manifest and layout, and one observable end-to-end slice, then independently verify and ship-check the delivered revision.

steps.objective: Provision the ticket branch and worktree from origin/master so implementation has an isolated writable checkout.

Read the binding design spec and stack-neutral PRD and produce the build contract: Astro + MDX stack decision recorded for docs/ARCHITECTURE.md, the source layout and manifest plan, and the concrete non-vacuous test_command and lint_command to declare in .operon/config.yaml, plus the first observable slice.
steps.selectionReason: Builder owns bounded contract definition; a contract pass fixes the already-decided stack and the meaningful gate commands before code so AC1-AC5 are provable rather than assumed.

steps.objective: Diagnose the typed blocked verdict returned by the first build/implement attempt against the build contract: identify what prevented the builder from producing the slice and record the concrete resolution the re-implementation must apply.
steps.selectionReason: The material event is that implement returned a typed blocked verdict; the builder-owned read-only diagnostic pass identifies the blocker and its resolution so the re-implementation carries new information rather than repeating the same block.

steps.objective: Re-attempt the first slice against the contract and the diagnostic brief that resolves the prior block: real pnpm/Astro manifest and source layout, ARCHITECTURE and RUNBOOK guidance replacing pending docs, at least one named behavior test, and stack-specific test_command/lint_command wired into .operon/config.yaml, then open the pull request.
steps.selectionReason: Builder is the only write-access role for this ticket; re-running implement with the diagnostic brief plus the build contract produces the narrow end-to-end slice and the PR terminal output now that the blocker is understood.

steps.objective: Run the newly declared test and lint gates against the delivered revision and finalize the pull request state as the merge candidate.

Independently verify the exact delivered revision against acceptance criteria AC1-AC5: stack rationale recorded, real manifest and layout, non-vacuous behavior test that fails when behavior breaks, meaningful lint command, and one observable runnable product slice.
steps.selectionReason: The required independent_review safety fact demands a reviewer distinct from the builder verifying the delivered revision and the non-vacuous gate claims.

steps.objective: Confirm the independent review verdict authorizes progression to ship readiness.
Perform the ship readiness check on the authorized revision and emit the merge verdict for the first product slice.
steps.selectionReason: Reviewer owns release readiness; a ship-check pass produces the merge verdict terminal output confirming the slice is shippable.

steps.objective: Record the ship decision for the merge-ready first product slice.
